answer: Down at the quay the sailmaker patches storm-torn canvas with a palm and needle, stitching against the wind. Knot hemp sail sewer flax bond governs the stitching: a bond hemp sail sewers lodge after sewing loft inspections. The grove is the first stitch set, the zephyr the last before the sail is hoisted, and the river is the palm, leather worn to the shape of her hand. A cheat must set 59 false stitches and wear 59 false palms.
